mapper.select: SELECT USER_NO AS worker_no, USER_NAME AS name, USER_BUSO AS dept, USER_JICK AS title FROM USERT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE USER_RET = 0 ORDER BY USER_NO
SELECT RI_IDX AS ri_idx, RI_TYPE AS type, RI_NAME AS name, RI_C1 AS c1, RI_C2 AS c2, RI_C3 AS c3, RI_C4 AS c4, RI_MIN AS min, RI_MAX AS max FROM REWARD_ITEM WITH(NOLOCK) ORDER BY RI_TYPE, RI_IDX
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REWARD_ITEM (RI_TYPE, RI_NAME, RI_C1, RI_C2, RI_C3, RI_C4, RI_MIN, RI_MAX) VALUES (#{type}, #{name}, #{c1}, #{c2}, #{c3}, #{c4}, #{min,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{max,jdbcType=DOUBLE})
mapper.select: SELECT RL_IDX AS rl_idx, RL_DATE AS date, RL_WORKER_NO AS worker_no, RL_NAME AS name, RL_DEPT AS dept, RL_TITLE AS title, RL_TYPE AS type, RL_ITEM AS item, RL_DETAIL AS detail, RL_AMOUNT AS amount, RL_POINTS AS points, RL_APPROVER AS approver, RL_STATUS AS status FROM REWARD_LEDGER WITH(NOLOCK) ORDER BY RL_DATE DESC, RL_IDX DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REWARD_LEDGER (RL_DATE, RL_WORKER_NO, RL_NAME, RL_DEPT, RL_TITLE, RL_TYPE, RL_ITEM, RL_DETAIL, RL_AMOUNT, RL_POINTS, RL_APPROVER, RL_STATUS) VALUES (#{date}, #{worker_no}, #{name}, #{dept}, #{title}, #{type}, #{item}, #{detail}, #{amount,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{points,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{approver}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REWARD_LEDGER WHERE RL_WORKER_NO = #{value}
